title: Rule 255 minimal IPv6 vectors carry an absent ICMPv6 header
description: Correctness review: test/vectors/rule_versioning.json:228-237 and test/vectors/schc_adaptation.json:68-76 label 6000000000003a40... as a valid minimal IPv6 packet. Payload Length is zero but Next Header is 58 (ICMPv6), so the declared upper-layer header is completely absent; a truly header-only IPv6 packet must use No Next Header (59/0x3b). spec/03-adaptation.md:389-393 requires Rule 255 payload to be a complete structurally valid IPv6 packet. Current security consumer does not validate these packets. Change the vectors to NH=59 or provide a complete ICMPv6 message, and add independent IPv6/next-header structural assertions.
